summary: End-to-end test of Fixed Expenses enhancements (date range filter, corporate expenses, view details modal, vendor/invoice fields, recurring templates & employees). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (filters, CRUD for corporate_employees & recurring_expense_templates, generate-recurring uses templates + is idempotent, vendor/invoice fields persist). Frontend: Found and fixed a CRITICAL runtime crash in the Add/Edit Template dialog: `<SelectItem value=''>None</SelectItem>` for the linked_employee_id Select — Radix Select forbids empty-string values, causing an 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay any time the Template dialog was opened while at least one corporate employee existed. This crash blocked scenarios 6, 7, 8, 9. After the fix (sentinel '__none__' value with mapping to '' in state), all UI scenarios pass: Date Range/Month toggle, View Details modal shows vendor + payment sections with all fields (payment_mode, payment_date, payment_reference, vendor, invoice_number), Corporate Expenses dialog with Templates+Employees tabs, Add/Edit/Delete Employee, Add/Edit/Delete Template, Generate Recurring (button works; API idempotency verified), Add Expense dialog includes Vendor + Invoice Number inputs.

rca of the issue: Bug: Radix UI's SelectItem throws 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string' when rendered with value=''. FixedExpenses.js used `<SelectItem value=''>None</SelectItem>` as the 'no employee' option in the linked_employee_id Select. The Select is only rendered when corporateEmployees.length > 0, which is exactly the scenario tested by scenarios 5-8 in sequence. Repro: create at least one corporate employee, then click 'Add Template' in Corporate Expenses > Templates tab. Result: full-page red overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors'. Fix: use sentinel value '__none__' for the SelectItem and translate '__none__' <-> '' inside the state setter, keeping the API payload unchanged (linked_employee_id remains '' when None chosen).
